newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble steady ahead of T-bill auctions, holidays.
newsitem.headline: Rouble steady ahead of T-bill auctions, holidays.

text.p: The rouble was steady on Monday ahead of Wednesday's government securities sales and dealers said banks were seeking funds, including cash, ahead of the holidays.
Markets are closed on May 1 and 2 for the May Day holidays, followed by Victory Day on May 9.
On April 30, the finance ministry will auction 7.5 trillion roubles of 322-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22081) and 4.0 trillion roubles of two-year OFZ government bonds (series 24012).
roubles/dollar Apr 28 midday Apr 28 early Apr 25 close
"The auctions remain the main source of demand," Avtobank dealer Sergei Gornev said.
Dealers said banks were rushing to square month-end balance sheets, with cash demand higher ahead of the long weekend.
